name: UT Health Houston ICON / Vape Nation Store Naloxone Vending
address: 523 South Magnolia Street (outside Vape Nation Store)
notes: Free anonymous 24/7 naloxone vending machine. Rural East Texas (Tyler County). Provided through UT Health Houston ICON program. Call ahead or check source; availability can change.

name: East Texas Council on Alcoholism and Drug Abuse (ETCADA) Naloxone Vending
notes: Free 24/7 naloxone vending machine outside ETCADA. Official Naloxone Texas regional hub for East Texas (serves ~23–35 rural counties). Dispensed 150+ containers in first month of operation. No ID or payment required.

notes: Free naloxone vending machine at Smokin Joker convenience store. Installed April 2026 via Heartstart Heroes and Naloxone Texas / UT Health San Antonio. 24/7 access. Serves rural Bowie County area.

name: Randy Sams’ Outreach Center / Heartstart Heroes Naloxone Vending
address: 402 Oak Street (lobby of Randy Sams’ Outreach Center)
notes: Free naloxone vending machine in the lobby. Installed April 2026 via Heartstart Heroes and Naloxone Texas. ADA-accessible. Serves surrounding rural East Texas communities. Call ahead for current stock.

name: Red Heart CPR Naloxone Vending
notes: Free 24/7 naloxone vending machine outside Red Heart CPR. First private-business machine in Hays County via Naloxone Texas / Be Well Texas / UT Health San Antonio. Limit of two boxes; no personal information required.

name: McMullen County OEM Naloxone Vending
address: 306 Live Oak Street (McMullen County Emergency Operations Center)
notes: Free anonymous 24/7 naloxone vending machine at the county EOC. Rural frontier access via Naloxone Texas / UT Health San Antonio Be Well Institute grant. Call ahead for current stock.

name: Bloomington VFD / Texas ICON Naloxone Vending
notes: Free naloxone vending machine at Bloomington Volunteer Fire Department. Partnership of UT Health Houston Texas ICON and Naloxone Texas. Rural access; stocked and maintained locally.

name: SAFE EP / Eagle Pass Fire Station Naloxone Vending
address: 590 Quarry St (downtown Eagle Pass Fire Station)
notes: Free naloxone vending machine launched October 2026 by SAFE EP and the City of Eagle Pass at the downtown fire station. Rural/border community access via Naloxone Texas. No cost; call ahead for hours or stock if needed.

name: SocialWorx Advocacy Group Free Naloxone
notes: Free walk-in naloxone (Narcan) available Monday–Friday, roughly 9 a.m.–4 p.m. East Texas nonprofit serving rural communities. Basic contact info may be requested for grant reporting; no cost.
